a: A partial `actions` entry merged on a sibling canvas's merge keeps that sibling's fields after it unmounts
A pick asked for another view takes the surface's id frames and LOD rungs, since `askedOwnView` never reads `viewId`
Hover in a declared view drops the view's camera, so parallax layers hover as if they moved with the camera, and hover and press disagree there
`viewport={{ inertia }}` without the `view` preset warns that it does nothing, though hand-tool inertia still works
b: doubleClickNames freezes the entered group at memo time, so a double-click after entering a group names the wrong node
A press routed to a `<CanvasView>` picks through the surface's layer gate, id frames and LOD, while hover in the same view uses the view's own gate
`tools={{ id: true }}` for a preset's own tool warns that the canvas offers no such tool, while mounting it
Departing ghosts draw a clipping container's children unclipped
A node removed from under a hidden container still in the scene fades out visibly
